description: Uptime Kuma monitoring configuration for Compliance Platform (CMP-42 / ADR-032 / NFR-012)

monitors.name: Compliance Platform API Health
monitors.description: Continuous synthetic probe verifying API, PostgreSQL, and AI Service health

down.subject: [Compliance Platform] Service DOWN
down.body: Alert: Compliance Platform API health check failed for 2 consecutive probes. Service is DOWN.

up.subject: [Compliance Platform] Service UP
up.body: Notice: Compliance Platform API health check recovered successfully. Service is UP.

maintenance.name: Weekly Routine Maintenance (ADR-032)
maintenance.description: Every Sunday 02:00-04:00 America/Mexico_City. Checks during this window are recorded as maintenance and excluded from downtime calculations per NFR-012.
